odia: ପୀଢ଼ା ଫାଟେ ନାହି ଲେଉଟେ ତେବେ ସେ ବ୍ରାହ୍ମଣ ଠାଆରୁ ଉଠ
title: A meal stretched into a taunt
literal_meaning: The stool cracks, the navel turns out—only then does that Brahmin rise from his place.
explanation: The meal is exaggerated until the stool cracks and the eater’s navel protrudes; only then does he get up. The bodily excess gives the taunt its force. Its attachment to a named caste is part of the saying’s prejudice, not evidence of how a community behaves.
meaning_odia: ଏତେ ଖାଇଲେ ଯେ ପୀଢ଼ା ଫାଟିଲା ଓ ନାହି ଓଲଟି ବାହାରିଲା; ତାହା ପରେ ଯାଇ ସେ ବ୍ରାହ୍ମଣ ଆସନରୁ ଉଠିଲେ। ଅତିଶୟ ଭୋଜନକୁ ବଢ଼ାଇଚଢ଼ାଇ ଏହି ଖୋଚା କରାଯାଇଛି। ଏହାକୁ କୌଣସି ଜାତିର ସମସ୍ତ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଆଚରଣ ବିଷୟରେ ସତ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ଧରିବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: An exaggerated meal ends only after the stool cracks and the eater’s navel protrudes.
odia_summary: ପୀଢ଼ା ଫାଟିବା ଓ ନାହି ଓଲଟିବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଖାଇ ସାରି ଉଠିବାର ଅତିଶୟ ଚିତ୍ର।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଜଣେ ପୀଢ଼ା ଫାଟିବାର ଛବିରେ ହସିଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଅତିଶୟତାରେ ହସିବା ଓ ଗୋଟିଏ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀକୁ ସେପରି ଭାବିବା ଏକା କଥା କି?” / In a reading discussion, someone laughs at the cracking stool. Another asks, “Is laughing at an exaggeration the same as believing it about a whole group?” This critical exchange is invented.
cultural_context: The cracking stool and protruding navel make overeating an extravagant bodily image. The ending describes the eater finally getting up.
